decks.notes: This Eldrazi Aggro deck focuses on quickly ramping out powerful Eldrazi creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer. By using cards like Lotus Petal and Eldrazi Temple, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its large threats early in the game. The deck also includes utility lands like Eye of Ugin and Blast Zone to provide additional advantages and answers to the opponent's board. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main idea of this Storm combo deck is to generate a large amount of mana quickly and cast a series of cheap spells in rapid succession to build up storm count and ultimately win the game with Tendrils of Agony. Other key cards include Gaea's Will for a mana boost, Song of Creation for card advantage, and Burning Wish for additional flexibility in finding key combo pieces. The deck also utilizes powerful artifacts like Mox Opal and Lion's Eye Diamond to accelerate its game plan. The land base includes fetch lands and Urza's Saga for consistency and resource generation.

This combo deck aims to generate infinite mana using cards like Basalt Monolith, Grim Monolith, and Paradox Engine while utilizing Mystic Forge to dig through the deck for key pieces. The deck utilizes artifact tutors like Karn, the Great Creator and Inventors' Fair to find combo pieces and disrupt opponents. The deck also includes control elements like Pithing Needle and Soul-Guide Lantern to disrupt opponents' strategies. The win condition is typically achieved through assembling a combo that generates infinite mana and then using it to cast powerful spells like Kozilek's Command or The One Ring.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly get powerful creatures into the graveyard and then reanimate them for a game-winning combo. The deck utilizes cards like Entomb and Reanimate to cheat creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty into play early on. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. The deck aims to control the board through removal spells like Fatal Push and Wasteland, while also providing card selection through Brainstorm and Ponder.

The key concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats efficiently and quickly. By utilizing a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and disruptive creatures, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and prevent the opponent from establishing a strong board presence. With powerful spells like Force of Will and Daze backing up aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower, the deck is able to apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's resources and strategies. Additionally, the deck's mana base and card selection tools help ensure consistency and flexibility in every game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of artifacts and card draw mechanics to generate a large amount of mana quickly and draw through the deck rapidly. By assembling the pieces in the right order, the deck can chain together spells and create a game-ending combo, such as using Grapeshot to deal massive damage to the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Defense Grid to protect its own combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and efficient combo.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with key creatures using cards like Entomb and Polluted Delta, and then bring them back onto the battlefield using spells like Animate Dead and Reanimate. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Wasteland. The deck thrives on reanimating creatures and out-valuing the opponent.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then bringing them back to the battlefield for big swings with cards like Animate Dead. It also includes counterspells like Daze and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces, as well as disruption like Thoughtseize and Wasteland to slow down the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to execute its combo quickly and efficiently, overwhelming the opponent with powerful reanimated creatures before they have a chance to respond.

This Eldrazi Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Glaring Fleshraker while disrupting the opponent with cards like Chalice of the Void and Kozilek's Command. It also utilizes lands like Eldrazi Temple and Eye of Ugin to efficiently cast its Eldrazi creatures. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive strategy and powerful threats, while also controlling the game with disruptive elements to secure victory in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on utilizing Cloudpost and Tron lands to ramp quickly into powerful threats such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Karn, the Great Creator while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Bojuka Bog and Wasteland. The deck aims to control the game through a combination of ramp, disruption, and powerful threats to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory. By carefully managing resources and timing key plays, the deck can outpace and outmaneuver opponents in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures from the graveyard, utilizing cards like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Entomb. By using disruption spells like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo pieces, and utilizing cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to find them quickly, the deck aims to bring out threats like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game to overwhelm the opponent. Wasteland and Daze provide additional disruption to control the board and secure the win.

The main objective of this deck is to assemble a powerful combo using cards like Mystic Forge, Basalt Monolith, Paradox Engine, and Voltaic Key. By generating a high amount of mana and using card draw and tutoring effects, the player aims to cast multiple spells in a single turn and potentially win the game by chaining together various powerful artifacts and abilities. The deck also includes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Grim Monolith to further support the combo strategy and maintain control over the battlefield.

This deck utilizes the combo of Nadu, Winged Wisdom with Nomads en-Kor and Springheart Nantuko to draw the entire library and win with Thassa's Oracle. It also includes multiple mana dorks and Green Sun's Zenith for consistency and ramping, along with protection cards like Sylvan Safekeeper. The mana base is optimized for quick and efficient mana production with Gaea's Cradle and fetch lands. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces and go off before the opponent can disrupt the strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively deploy Eldrazi creatures, leveraging powerful mana acceleration and disruptive cards like Chalice of the Void to control the game. It aims to put pressure on the opponent early while disrupting their own game plan with cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Sowing Mycospawn. The inclusion of cards like Eldrazi Temple and Ancient Tomb allow for explosive starts, while Elvish Spirit Guide and Once Upon a Time provide consistency in finding the right pieces. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats and efficient disruption.

The main concept of this deck is to use powerful Eldrazi creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. The deck focuses on utilizing Eldrazi Temple and Eye of Ugin to cheat out large creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and It That Heralds the End early in the game. Chalice of the Void and Sowing Mycospawn help control the opponent's resources, while cards like Wasteland and Glaring Fleshraker disrupt their mana base. Overall, the goal of the deck is to apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on using disruptive creatures and removal spells to control the board while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's plans with cards like Thoughtseize and Opposition Agent, while using efficient removal like Fatal Push and Swords to Plowshares. Aether Vial allows for cheating creatures into play, while cards like Flickerwisp and Skyclave Apparition provide additional utility. The deck also utilizes powerful creatures like Samwise the Stouthearted and Overlord of the Balemurk to close out the game quickly. The mana base is optimized for consistency and disruption, with Wasteland and Karakas providing extra utility against certain strategies.
